scope: All future LevLine/Sunday Signal research, data collection, model development, compute and public deployment.
principles: Technical availability never overrides the zero-cost rule.
Source rights, point-in-time validity and reliability remain independent gates even when a source is free.
If no free point-in-time-qualified source exists, the feature remains blocked rather than substituted with hindsight data or a paid feed.
Completed 2026 game outcomes remain prohibited for model or architecture selection under the existing research firewall.

approved_zero_cost_paths.rights_note: Retain source-specific attribution and redistribution controls.
CC-BY-SA-4.0 via nflverse; attribution to FTN Data via nflverse required.
U.S. National Weather Service open data; preserve source attribution and do not imply endorsement.

approved_zero_cost_paths.quota_policy: Never exceed the free allocation; retain a reserve and fail closed when depleted.
approved_zero_cost_paths.endpoint_policy: Current/live endpoints only. Paid historical endpoints are prohibited.
approved_zero_cost_paths.redistribution_policy: Persist analytical/derived research features rather than repackaging the raw feed as a standalone data product.

approved_zero_cost_paths.compute_policy: Standard GitHub-hosted runners only; no paid larger runners.
